motionSystems.name: Cinematic Descent
motionSystems.purpose: Tie chapter progression to a continuous camera, depth, or material journey.
motionSystems.reducedMotion: Use discrete chapter states with no camera travel.

motionSystems.name: Guided Scene Handoff
motionSystems.purpose: Move between approved proof states using explicit next and previous controls.
motionSystems.reducedMotion: Jump or crossfade between complete states.

motionSystems.name: Masked Chapter Wipe
motionSystems.purpose: Use occlusion to make a chapter transition feel physical and editorial.

motionSystems.name: Focus Pull Reveal
motionSystems.purpose: Shift visual attention through bounded blur, contrast, or light rather than generic translation.
avoid: large full-screen blur on low-end mobile
motionSystems.reducedMotion: Reveal fully sharp with a short opacity transition.

motionSystems.name: Evidence Migration
motionSystems.purpose: Move a fact, metric, or artifact from its source chapter into persistent context after it earns importance.
motionSystems.reducedMotion: Duplicate the fact at the destination only after the source leaves.

motionSystems.name: Object Orbit Inspection
motionSystems.purpose: Let rotation or camera movement reveal product structure, hotspots, or state.
avoid: objects that communicate no more than a still
motionSystems.reducedMotion: Use manual controls or a poster with labeled states.

motionSystems.name: Material State Morph
motionSystems.purpose: Change color, surface, lighting, or form to represent real configuration or status.
motionSystems.reducedMotion: Switch state without interpolation and preserve labels.

motionSystems.name: Spatial Zoom Transition
motionSystems.purpose: Preserve location when entering or leaving a detail from a map, gallery, or collection.
avoid: routine navigation with no spatial relationship
motionSystems.reducedMotion: Crossfade while preserving focus and scroll position.

motionSystems.name: Kinetic Type Punctuation
motionSystems.purpose: Use one typographic transformation to punctuate a thesis or chapter boundary.
motionSystems.reducedMotion: Render the final type state immediately.

motionSystems.name: Interface Shared Element
motionSystems.purpose: Preserve continuity between list, detail, panel, and overlay states.
motionSystems.reducedMotion: Use instant layout change with focus placement.

motionSystems.name: Command Palette Summon
motionSystems.purpose: Open a high-frequency command surface with immediate focus and precise feedback.
motionSystems.reducedMotion: Open instantly with focus in the input.

motionSystems.name: Data State Morph
motionSystems.purpose: Explain changes between filters, time ranges, selections, or outcomes.
motionSystems.reducedMotion: Update immediately and announce the new state.

motionSystems.name: Parallax Depth Field
motionSystems.purpose: Create controlled depth between a focal subject and environmental layers.
motionSystems.reducedMotion: Freeze the layers in a composed still.

motionSystems.name: Ambient Loop
motionSystems.purpose: Keep a scene alive without asking the visitor to follow a narrative beat.
avoid: meaningful content that exists only in motion
motionSystems.reducedMotion: Use the poster or a quiet nonspatial state.
